1/4 tsp baking soda

1/4 cup milk

1 1/2 cups shredded cottage cheese

Roll out the dough on the floured work surface into a thin circle about 1/4 inch thick.  Fold the dough in half, and roll it out again, rotating the dough occasionally, until it is about 1/8 inch thick.  Crimp the edges together and press the seam inwards.  Brush the top of the dough with milk.

Heat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.  Place the dough on a baking sheet and brush the edges with more milk.
